about: edit_note's quote rules (M55.5), held by both twins: src-tauri/src/vault/quote.rs (replays_the_shared_quote_cases) and src/engine/quote.ts (src/engine/quote.test.ts). `body` is the note body exactly as get_note prints it after its --- line; `prefix` is every byte before it (BOM, fences and YAML), never matched or changed. Matching is exact and counts overlapping matches. A case lands as `result`, with `lines` the 1-based line where each edit's new text starts, in the order given, or is `refused` with the exact message. Rust offsets are bytes and TS offsets UTF-16 units, so only lines and code-point contexts are pinned. Non-ASCII and control characters are written as \u escapes.

cases.why: A unique quote is replaced, and nothing else changes.
cases.body:
# How we schedule

We ship on Thursdays, after the freeze.
Thursdays are quiet.
cases.result:
# How we schedule

We ship on Thursdays, after the Wednesday freeze.
Thursdays are quiet.

cases.why: A quote may span lines; the new text starts on the line the old one did.
cases.body:
# How we schedule

We ship on Thursdays, after the freeze.
Thursdays are quiet.
cases.result:
# How we schedule

We ship on Thursdays, after the freeze.

Fridays are busy.

cases.why: An empty `new` deletes the passage.

cases.why: Adjacent passages are two edits, not an overlap.
cases.body: abcdef

cases.why: A quote that appears twice is refused, listing both with line and context.
cases.body:
# How we schedule

We ship on Thursdays, after the freeze.
Thursdays are quiet.
cases.refused:
Edit 1: the quoted text appears 2 times. Pass `occurrence` (counting from 1) or quote a longer passage:
  1. line 3: "# How we schedule

We ship on Thursdays, after the freeze.
Thursdays are quiet.…"
  2. line 4: "…We ship on Thursdays, after the freeze.
Thursdays are quiet.
"
Nothing was written.
